book.title: Mak Magaŋ Zisasiyet yaŋaŋ meluwaŋ kapi mge

content: Zuda an ŋeŋaŋ ekŋenaŋ Zisas kume gakikiyelen zembiliwebien

Zuda amgalen Aŋgalalaŋ Kendo Nupmamaŋ Yispiŋ Niniyelen Kendo kasup zut delaŋ zemeŋgut tatagalen tapme sâpe sâpe bumbu an ŋeŋaŋ ma zii zet zikat indanda ekŋenaŋ Zisas buzakset atamti betnaŋ zamti kume gakikiyelen zemkabewien.
Yaŋgut naman pigok zemti kiŋgabien, “Mineti nin kendo kanen pigogat msenup beme amnaŋ kasa kileŋ kuseipmagengapmti pemann talak.” Zemti peme tage.
Imbi ŋeneyaŋ Zisasiyet ŋokŋan welaŋ mulage

Zisasiyaŋ Betani mkaen Saimon itnaŋaŋ an liŋgit satmak mamtanaŋ weyaŋpeye egalen mkaen meu nini mundumen totapme imbi ŋenaŋ wet kelakŋaŋ sesikŋaŋ dolakŋaŋ kwitnaŋ nalat ke okop nanzaŋaŋ weyayaŋaŋ keyet keŋan tapme mkoti butnaŋ ŋilikŋaŋ gwaen kume etume Zisasiyet ŋokŋan mulapme toge. Wet ke tosaŋaŋ mobotnaŋ penaŋ.
Kegok mme am notnaŋ ekŋenaŋ ekme ŋep kumbeme ilinak zenâ zenâ mti zewien, “Pi kwilekiyet penaŋ wet tosaŋaŋ mobotnaŋ penaŋ pi belak kileŋ walezin?
Egaŋ wet kapi nin ndame mmet bemann tosaŋaŋ 300 kina mee kegok ndame am bekopsat ekŋen kalaŋ indawanek ze ŋep benak.” Zemti imbi keyet nâme bekanaŋ beye.
Âpme Zisasiyaŋ nâmti pigok diindoye, “Imbi kapiyaŋ neŋmagen mulup dolakŋaŋ mipgat in egat zet ŋen zenzepiŋ belak peme talak.
Am bekopsat ekŋen pi inmak kwesiŋ kapi mamambepgapmti in kwileki ŋen miindasâgât nâmti ŋep miindawep. Âpme neŋ inmak msalen kapi kwesiŋ ewe ku mambap.
Belatnik bugan bukapi tapmoti gakima am sumen nabewepgapmti egaŋ ikŋaŋgat keŋan galak eweŋanak wet sesikŋaŋ dolakŋaŋaŋ mulati zulutnein.
Neŋ penaŋ sukwep zema nâit. Am msat kataŋ Kawawaŋgalen Zet Zapat Dolakŋaŋ Penaŋ zemebep kataŋ imbi kapiyaŋ kwitnaŋ kwitnaŋ mnain keyet zapatnaŋ eyo zeme manâmambep.”
Zudayaŋ amobotnaŋ ekŋengat zikalinan Zisas zemkukuyet zetik mimindeye
Zisasiyet nembaŋane 12 ekŋenmagengatnaŋ nemba ŋen Zudas Iskaliot mkaengatnan egaŋ sâpe sâpe bumbu an ŋeŋaŋ ekŋenmagen meti Zisas zemsokbemindandayet zemkaliŋ bemindeye.
Kegok zeme sâpe sâpe bumbu an ŋeŋaŋ ekŋenaŋ nâmti oloŋen mti dopmaŋ mânep sasayet zetik mpeme Zudayaŋ set ŋen aikti Zisas zemsokbemindame atatayet mulupmaŋ mge.
Zisasiyaŋ nembaŋanemak Aŋgalalaŋ Kendoyet meu bimbiŋgat nimbien

Nupmamaŋ yispiŋ niniyelen kendo ke kan sokŋanik beme am ekŋenaŋ sipsip makumbumtemien kan ke beyeyepm nembaŋaneyaŋ Zisasiyet yaŋkwesiwien, “Nin mkan den meti Aŋgalalaŋ Kendo tati tu meu niniyet weyaŋ besenup?”
Yaŋkwesime Zisasiyaŋ nembaŋane zut zemidemti zeye, “It Zelusalem mka teman moti ekmalu an ŋenaŋ tu menzim belen mmepme aikti keyegak baman mâti mepmalu
egaŋ mka ŋengat mowepme ekti keyegak mâpmoti mka keyet toŋaŋgat zeselup, ‘Amobotnaŋaŋ pigok zemndeme kolup. Neŋ nembannemak Aŋgalalaŋ Kendoyelen meu mka keŋaŋ de tati nsenup?’
Zemalu egaŋ idati mka keŋan temaŋ tedukŋan gwaenen kwitnaŋ kwitnaŋ eweŋanak weyaŋ bembeŋaŋ ke zikat idame it meu ke bumbemalu kot nsenup.”
Zisasiyaŋ kegok diidome egelaŋ meti kwitnaŋ kwitnaŋ zeye keyet kataŋ penaŋ aikti Aŋgalalaŋ Kendoyelen meu niniyet weyaŋ tabumbemambun.
Âpme msat tambusât tapmme Zisasiyaŋ nembaŋane 10 indatimti mka keyet keŋan mopmâbien.

Motati meu nini mundumen totati meu nimambe Zisasiyaŋ pigok zeye, “Neŋ penaŋ sukwep penaŋ zema nâit, inmagengatnan nemba ŋenaŋ meu neŋmak pelep kwep tatnilup egaŋ zemnome kasa ekŋengat belinan bemneme ekŋenaŋ nome gakiwap.”
Zeme nembaŋane ekŋenaŋ nâme nukŋaŋ beme Zisasiyet igak kwep kwep pigok yaŋkwesiwien, “Mneti nâgât mene tazemasenigat zema nâmbi?”
Kegok yaŋkwesime egaŋ pigok diindoye, “Nemba neŋmak nsakwep nupmamaŋ tu batien pemalu towepme mkwat nselup an keyet nâmti tazeyap.
Kawawaŋgalen Zet Itnaŋanen neŋ Angat Nemuŋaŋaŋ neŋ zemâtâtneneŋaŋnok meti gakikiyelen zemneneŋaŋ. Wakae, neŋ zemnowe an ke sindem omba penaŋ tiwe. An ke mamaŋaŋ ku ambetnak ze dolakŋaŋ penaŋ benak.”
Zemti Zisasiyaŋ nupmamaŋ ŋen mti Kawawaŋgat wisikŋ zemutumti indamti zeye, “In mti nit kapi nanaŋgat sek sesumban.”
Nime delaŋ zeme wain okop tageen ke mti Kawawaŋgat wisikŋ zemti kegogak indame nimbien.
Nime zeye, “Kapi tâtâ alakŋaŋ ammak Kawawaŋmak sipmnaŋ tusum indeyap. Ke am sambe ekŋen yomengatnan indatim kwakwagat nâmti kegok mbap.”
Kegok zemti zeye, “Neŋ penaŋ sukwep zema nâit, neŋ wain tu ke ninipiŋ maneti bamgat kululuŋen gwaen mama katikŋanen tati wain niyap kaboŋ yek; wain alakŋaŋ nimbap.”
Zeme delaŋ zeme keyegak tapeŋ tati sesewat silik kume delaŋ zeme mkaengatnan toti tambuyelak Olip Kalaŋan mowebien.
Pitayaŋ Zisas yaŋpewe keyet zetnaŋ zeye
Motati Zisasiyaŋ nembaŋane pigok diindoye, “In kasa kuku an ekŋenaŋ kopme ekŋengat kiŋgati nemkunzuŋ mekopme nenak etaŋ teŋtewat tasap. Kawawaŋgalen Zet Itnaŋanen Kawawaŋaŋ ikŋaŋ pigok zeye,

content.text: ‘Neŋ sipsip damuŋ kuma gakime sipsip ekŋenaŋ kileŋ lala bubuk kunzuŋ mekobep.’ (Zekaraia 13:7)

content: Yaŋgut bam Kawawaŋaŋ neŋ mme gakikiengatnan gilik zem watiŋgut Galili msalen mepma in bam napmâti kobep.”
Zeme Pitayaŋ pigok zeye, “Nemba notnaŋaŋ bamkumgemeseip yaŋgut neŋ ŋep ku bamkumgemesap.”
Zeme Zisasiyaŋ dopmaŋ pigok gilik zem saye, “Alak tambumbu kapiyet sakokolok apmaŋ kwitnaŋ sakwep kumti sek zut ewe kukupiŋ tapme geŋ nâgât sek tuk yaŋnesenik.”
Zeme Pitayaŋ zekaŋkaŋ mti zeye, “Neŋ nome gakikiyelen mseiwaŋgut neŋ geŋ ku yaŋgesap penaŋ.” Zeme nemba notnaŋ sambe ekŋenaŋ zet sepemaŋ kwep kegogak zemâbien.
Zisasiyaŋ Gesemani muluwen dunduye
Zemti ilinsakwep Gesemane muluwen mebien. Mepataŋ zemti Zisasiyaŋ nembaŋaneyet zeye, “In kapi totapme neŋ nenak mulup butnan daen metati dundumti kosap.”
Zemindemti Zisasiyaŋ nembaŋane tuk Pitamak Zems ma Zân indatimti mege. Âpme yaŋbemti nukŋaŋ sambe penaŋ keyet nâmti keŋaŋ sindem igagaŋ penaŋ beme sek monzalamaŋ ululuŋ pem toge.
Mti nembaŋane tuk ekŋengat zeye, “Neŋ keŋŋ sindem beme gakikiyelenok tatnâyapgat in kapi kaik tapmaseip.”

Kegok zemti belaknik bugan meti keŋaŋ nukŋaŋ beme msalen ŋenzimosetnaset palak palak tokutumwemti pigok dunduye, “Bien, geŋ set eleŋ belaŋ ŋen aiknanayelen nâsenik beme aiknamane sindem temaŋ timti ku gakisap.”
Kegok dundumti zeye, “Bien, Bien, geŋ nâmane sindem temaŋ kapiyaŋ dukŋnan ku mosem. Yaŋgut nâlen zet zeap ke mâti msenik yek; giti nâmtadik keyet kataŋ mâsenik.”

Kegok dundum delaŋ zemti nembaŋane tuk ekŋenmagen gilik zem koti indikme meluk taweme Saimon Pitayet zeye, “Pita, geŋ ewe kegogak meluk tawenik? Kan belaknik bugan kaik tati otnânâ mulup bugan ku mbek?
In mama mimi bekananen ku toindondoyet nâmti eksem kaik tati dundundu mulup mit. Keŋinaŋ nâgât kembeŋ nâyo yaŋgut sekŋinaŋ nukŋaŋ bein.”
Zemti ewe gilik zem met zet Bipmaŋgat dunduye kegogak ewe zemdunduye.
Dundum delaŋ zemti koindikme zikalin ewe melugaŋ kwasime taweme keyet zeme ekŋenaŋ zet dopmaŋ gilik zem sasayet timabien.
Âpme met sek tuk ewe dundumti gilik zem koindikme ewe muluk taweme zeye, “In ewe tagomti meluk tawep? Angat Nemuŋaŋ neŋ zemnomti am yomtoŋ ekŋengalen belen mobogalen kann ilak sokŋanik bein.
Wapme an neŋ zemsokbemneneyelen walek kozingat meti ekne!”
Zudasiyaŋ meti kasa ekŋen Zisas zikat indame atawien

Zisasiyaŋ nembaŋaneyet zapat kegok diindomambe tapme nemba 12 ekŋengat tuŋguwinangatnaŋ ŋen Zudasiyaŋ piwan kasa kuku an ŋeŋaŋ bemindeme kobien. Zudasiyaŋ sâpe sâpe bumbu an ŋeŋaŋ ma zii zet zikat indanda an ma sesewat mka temaŋgalen an damuŋ notnaŋ ekŋenaŋ kasa kuku an notnaŋ ekmak zemindeme wanam kukŋaŋmak ma tepemaŋ mee pi belen belen timti kopmâbien.
Selen kopmambe Zudasiyaŋ pigok zemâtâtindeye, “Neŋ meti an mkumpema in ekti keyegak weyaŋ atamti bembuluŋ wapmeseip.”
Zemindatim koti keyegak Zisasmagen meti “Amobotnaŋŋ” zemti ambet mkumpeye.
Kegok mme ekti kasa ekŋenaŋ met betnanen atam kitik mti tabien.
Âpme Zisasiyet nembaŋane ekŋenmagengatnaŋ ŋenaŋ ŋeŋaŋ zime wanam kukŋaŋmak pitakŋanengatnan mandapeme kwapme sâpe sâpe bumbu an ŋeŋaŋgat mulup anaŋ wakŋaŋ nembet sâmpeye.
Âpme Zisasiyaŋ pigok diindoye, “In nâgât nâme kambu titi an bema wanam kukŋaŋmak ma tepemaŋ mee pi timti kot natam kitik mtalip?
Neŋ kan kataŋ inmak sosok sesewat mka temanen an imbi Zet Zapat Dolakŋaŋ diindomti mamtemanen ke in ku natawien. Yaŋgut alak pi Kawawaŋgalen Zet Itnaŋan nâgât meluwaŋ mimiŋaŋ keyet kataŋ sokbein.”
Zeme nembaŋane sambe ekŋenaŋ kiŋgati pemkuŋkunzuŋmâpme delaŋ zeye.
Notnaŋaŋ kuŋkunzuŋ mâpme Zisas nembaŋane ekŋenmagengatnan nemba zomolim ŋen saŋgum kwewetaŋaŋ kaik mamaŋgeyaŋ atanup zem saŋgumaŋ kwep mâtât mtapme belak talak kunzuŋ mege.
Ekŋenaŋ Zisas sâpe sâpe bumbu an ŋeŋaŋ ekŋengat temaŋin ma amobotnaŋ notnaŋ ekŋenmagen wapmebien
Sâpe sâpe bumbu an ŋeŋaŋ ekŋen ma zii zet zikat indanda an ma damuŋ notnaŋ ekŋenaŋ sâpe sâpe bumbu an ŋeŋaŋin temaŋ egalen mkaen met ondek tati Zisas taekme Zisas zem kukuyet nâmti ekmagen wati

tapmepme Pitayaŋ baman mâti kiŋgapeŋ beŋan daen igak takopmaŋge. Koti ekŋenaŋ zem kuku mka kimbalen toti mka keŋan mowepme Pitayaŋ kegogak kimbat keŋan toweti zupman baen sâpe sâpe bumbu an sambe ekŋengat ŋeŋaŋin egalen mulup anaŋ tep bum kâtapmambienen toti tep kâti tapmaŋge.
Âpme ekŋen sâpe sâpe bumbu an ŋeŋaŋ ma amobotnaŋ sambe ekŋenaŋ ondekti Zisasiyet nukŋaŋaŋ ŋen aikti kume gakikiyet zemtimapme beye.
Am sambe ekŋenaŋ Zisas zemkukuyelen zet dâsuki notnaŋ bemzem zewienaŋgut zelinaŋ sepem igak igak bemâge.

Âpme an notnaŋaŋ ondedagen tabienaŋ wati Zisasiyaŋ zet zeme nâmbien ke mti pigok zewien, “Nin sek ŋen tatnâmann Zisasiyaŋ kapigok zeye, ‘Neŋ sesewat mka temaŋ amnaŋ walabien bekapi ŋep asekti kasup tugat keŋan neŋ alakŋaŋ ŋen walabap.’”
Zet notnaŋ kogok zewien keyaŋ zelin sepemaŋ kwewagak ku bemâge.
Mme sâpe sâpe bumbu an ŋeŋaŋ ekŋengat ŋeŋaŋinaŋ wat zimoselinan tati Zisasiyet pigok yaŋkwesiye, “Ekŋenaŋ gâgât zet sambe tabem zep; kapi geŋ dopmaŋ ŋen gilik zem indandayelen ŋen nânik ma yek?”
Yaŋkwesime Zisasiyaŋ belak zetnepiŋ tapme naman ŋen pigok yaŋkwesiye, “Kawawaŋ masesewatsanup egat Nemuŋaŋ Kilais kokotnaŋgat damuŋ matatnuwan, geŋ kapi?”

Yaŋkwesime Zisasiyaŋ zeye, “Penaŋ ke zenikmak. Neŋ Kilais. Angat Nemuŋaŋaŋ neŋ yaŋ bam in nikme neŋ winde toŋaŋ Kawawaŋgalen betnaŋ penaset tati gilik zem am indatisât msalen zanza palen tati tobap.” (Sam 110:1; Daniel 7:13)
Zeme sâpe sâpe bumbu an ŋeŋaŋ sambe ekŋengat ŋeŋaŋin bekeyaŋ nâme bekanaŋ beme ŋenzinziŋ palen ikŋaŋgat melakanduŋaŋ mendalemti zeye, “Kwilekiyet zet sambe ewe tusumzesenup?
Egaŋ Kawawaŋgat zet mobotnaŋ penaŋ min keyepmti in zuk nâip?” Zeme am sambe ekŋenaŋ zemdelaŋ zemti zewien, “Ek gakikiyelen zapat etaŋ bein.”

Zemdelaŋ zeme keyegak notnaŋaŋ yaŋbemti zawagaŋ wasekpewien ma notnaŋaŋ zikatnaŋ melakanduŋaŋ zampeme tapme kumti zewien, “Kwiyaŋ goin? Ze zemane nâne.” Tapmme sâpe sâpe bumbu an sambe ekŋengat ŋeŋaŋin egalen mulup an ekŋenaŋ kwapem penaŋ kuwien.
Pitayaŋ Zisasiyet yaŋpeye
Âpme Pitayaŋ mka temaŋ keyet kimbat keŋan tep kât tapme sâpe sâpe bumbu an sambe ekŋengat ŋeŋaŋinaŋgat mulup imbi ŋenaŋ koti Pita ekmototi zeye, “Geŋ kapiyaŋ Zisas Nasalet mkaengatnaŋ ekmak manik.”
Zeme Pitayaŋ yaŋpemti zeye, “Geŋ zet tazenigen ke yaŋaŋ ku nâyap.” Zemti set tokwakwalen metowesât mme sakokologaŋ kwitnaŋ yaŋbem kâkâkâââk kuye.
Âpme imbi keyaŋ metneti Pita ewe aikti am tabien ekŋengat zeye, “An kapi Zisasiyelen maŋgeyengatnaŋaŋ tazin.”
Imbi keyaŋ kok zeme Pitayaŋ ewe yaŋge belaknik tapmetneti am tabien ekŋenaŋ Pitayet zewien, “Penaŋ, geŋ ekŋengalen maŋgeengatnaŋ Galili msalengatnan kopmanan.”
Zeme Pitayaŋ zeye, “Neŋ Kawawaŋgat zikatnan penaŋ zeyap, an ke ku nâyap. Neŋ dâsuki zeyap beme Kawawaŋaŋ nâgât sekŋ ŋep saik kumnewe.”

Zemambe tati nâme sakokolok apmaŋaŋ kwitnaŋ sek zut kume Pitayaŋ eweŋan baenen Zisasiyaŋ, “Sakokolok kwitnaŋ zut kukupiŋ tapme geŋ yaŋnemane sek tuk bewe,” zeye ke otnâmti keŋan bekanaŋ penaŋ beme si sum ŋetŋet temaŋ mti tusumti suye.

footnotes.text: Wain alakŋaŋ Zisasiyaŋ nsât zeye ke ikŋaŋ mama kanzizilen ningat Amobotnaŋ tati mama ekmagengatnaŋ kopme timti ekmak nimwiaŋwiaŋ kwesiŋ mti mambanup keyet zeye.
